acceptanceCriteria: The three Core workflows pass on Corvint, Beamfall and one owner-selected untouched public repository, with cases frozen before execution.
Cases are frozen before execution and no implementation tuning follows unsealing without invalidating the candidate.
Failures, exclusions, retries and unsupported scope remain in the promotion packet.
body:
Validate the immutable candidate on an untouched external repository after internal dogfood has passed.

2026-09-29 untouched-repository admission blocker: spf13/cobra at adbc8813901bba65827259daa8e22ff94ec1f30e was already used in retained development evaluations benchmarks/results/v4-development-go.json and benchmarks/results/v4-development.json (repositories[2], corpus SHA256 d744bec14c6ee54f03082b5db4a2897f4d77e1cf928dd4a886c63af0dbe8e3ad). This conflicts with claiming it as untouched for PRS-V1-008. Heldout cases remain unopened and no evaluation was launched. Qualification preparation is producing a concrete untouched replacement or explicitly labelled owner-approved deviation; do not count existing Cobra results as untouched qualification. Retain original failed run and decision0425 without rewriting history.

2026-09-29 owner disposition (verified user reply in coordinating chat01a0ecf6-27fe-7521-b6ed-9e9db3cd17ad): Use urfave/cli (recommended), conditioned on final provenance check finding no prior Corvint use. Prepare immutable source pin and existing-protocol prospective decision/preregistration; independent review before sealing or publication. Do not execute or tune any candidate on selected cases before that boundary. Cobra and chi histories remain retained; replacement admission is not qualification success.
title: Validate the release candidate on untouched repositories
